G5601.def:
**Ἰωβήδ** (WH, -βήλ, Lk, l.with; Rec., RV, Ὠβήδ), ὁ, indecl.,
**Jo bed **(Obed): [[Mat.1.5|Mat.1:5]], [[Luk.3.32|Luk.3:32]].†
(AS)

G5613.def:
**ὡς**, adverbial form of the relative pron. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ.
I. As _relat. adv._ of manner, **as, like as, just as, even as**;
1. **with a demonstrative, like οὕτως, expressed or understood**: οὕτως . . . ὡς, [[Mrk.4.26|Mrk.4:26]], [[1Co.3.15|1Co.3:15]], [[Eph.5.28|Eph.5:28]], [[Jas.2.12|Jas.2:12]], al.; ὡς . . . οὕτως, [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]], [[1Co.7.17|1Co.7:17]], al.; elliptically (sc. οὕτως, οὕτω), with nom., [[Mat.6.29|Mat.6:29]], al.; with accusative, [[Mat.19.19|Mat.19:19]], [[Mrk.12.31|Mrk.12:31]], al.; with prep., [[Mat.26.55|Mat.26:55]], [[Mrk.14.48|Mrk.14:48]], [[Luk.22.52|Luk.22:52]], [[Jhn.7.10|Jhn.7:10]], al.; with verb., [[Jhn.15.6|Jhn.15:6]], [[2Co.3.1|2Co.3:1]], [[Eph.2.3|Eph.2:3]], [[1Th.5.6|1Th.5:6]], al.; with ptcp. (the ptcp. however not having the special force wh. it has in cl.; see Bl., §73, 5; 74, 6), [[Mat.7.29|Mat.7:29]], [[Mrk.1.22|Mrk.1:22]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], al.; freq implying opinion or belief, [[Rom.9.32|Rom.9:32]] so esp, with genitive absol., [[1Co.4.18|1Co.4:18]], [[2Co.5.20|2Co.5:20]], [[1Pe.4.12|1Pe.4:12]], [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]].
2. Before numerals, **about, nearly**: [[Mrk.5.13|Mrk.5:13]], [[Jhn.1.40|Jhn.1:40]], [[Act.5.7|Act.5:7]], al.
3. Before adjectives and adverbs, **how**: [[Rom.10.15; 11.33|Rom.10:15 11:33]], [[1Th.2.10|1Th.2:10]]; with superl., ὡς τάχιστα, **as quickly as possible**, [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]]
II. As conjunction;
1. temporal,
(a) **as, when, since**: [[Mrk.9.21; 14.72|Mrk.9:21 14:72]], [[Luk.1.23|Luk.1:23]], [[Jhn.2.9|Jhn.2:9]], al.;
(b) **while, when, as long as**: [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]], [[Jhn.12.36|Jhn.12:36]], [[Gal.6.10|Gal.6:10]] (Field, _Notes_, 191); ὡς ἄν (M, _Pr._, 167, and see: ἄν), [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]], [[1Co.11.34|1Co.11:34]], [[Php.2.23|Php.2:23]].
2. Final, **in order that**; with inf., **in order to** (M, _Pr._, 204n), [[Luk.9.52|Luk.9:52]], [[Act.20.24|Act.20:24]], [[Heb.7.9|Heb.7:9]].
(AS)

G5610.def:
**ὥρα**, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה ;]
1. any **time** or **period** fixed by nature, esp. a **season** (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.).
2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, **an hour**: [[Mat.24.36|Mat.24:36]], [[Mrk.13.32|Mrk.13:32]], [[Act.10.3|Act.10:3]], al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, _Pr._, 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), [[Jhn.4.52|Jhn.4:52]], [[Act.10.3, 30|Act.10:3, 30]] [[1Co.15.30|1Co.15:30]], [[Rev.3.3|Rev.3:3]]; accusative of duration, [[Mat.20.12, 26|Mat.20:12 26]], [[Mrk.14.37|Mrk.14:37]]; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, **for a season, for a time**, [[Jhn.5.35|Jhn.5:35]], [[2Co.7.8|2Co.7:8]], [[Gal.2.5|Gal.2:5]]; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, **for a short season** (**ICC**, in l.), [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]]
3. A definite point of time, **time, hour**: [[Mat.26.45|Mat.26:45]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.1.10; 14.17|Luk.1:10 14:17]], [[Rev.3.10|Rev.3:10]], al.; with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.22.53|Luk.22:53]], [[Jhn.2.4; 7.30|Jhn.2:4 7:30]], al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, [[1Co.4.11|1Co.4:11]] ἐσχάτη ὥ., [[1Jn.2.18|1Jn.2:18]] before ὅτε, [[Jhn.4.21, 23; 5.25; 16.25|Jhn.4:21, 23 5:25 16:25]]; ἵνα, [[Jhn.12.23|Jhn.12:23]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]] (cf. _DB_, ext., 475b 476b).
(AS)

G5620.def:
**ὥσ-τε **
consecutive particle,
1. with infin., **expressing result, so as to**: [[Mat.8.24; 12.22|Mat.8:24 12:22]], [[Mrk.1.27|Mrk.1:27]], [[Luk.5.7|Luk.5:7]], [[Act.1.19|Act.1:19]], [[Rom.7.6|Rom.7:6]], [[1Co.1.7|1Co.1:7]], [[Heb.13.6|Heb.13:6]], al.; of a designed result, [[Mat.10.1|Mat.10:1]], [[Luk.4.29|Luk.4:29]], al.; preceded by οὕτως, [[Act.14.1|Act.14:1]] by τοσοῦτος, [[Mat.15.33|Mat.15:33]]
2. C. indic.,
(a) **so that**: [[Gal.2.13|Gal.2:13]], preceded by οὕτως, [[Jhn.3.16|Jhn.3:16]]
(b) **so then, therefore**: [[Mat.12.12|Mat.12:12]], [[Mrk.2.28|Mrk.2:28]], [[Rom.7.4|Rom.7:4]], [[1Co.3.7|1Co.3:7]], [[Gal.3.9|Gal.3:9]], al.
3. **so then, therefore**: with subjc., [[1Co.5.8|1Co.5:8]] with imperat., [[1Co.3.21; 4.5|1Co.3:21 4:5]], [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]] [[1Th.4.18|1Th.4:18]], [[1Pe.4.19|1Pe.4:19]], al
(AS)

G5602.def:
**ὧδε**, _adv._,
[in LXX for חֲלֹם ,פֹּה ,הִנֶּה, etc. ;]
1. prop., of manner, **so** (Hom., al.).
2. In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place,
(a) **hither** (BL, §25, 2): [[Mat.8.29|Mat.8:29]], [[Mrk.11.3|Mrk.11:3]], [[Luk.9.41|Luk.9:41]], [[Jhn.6.25|Jhn.6:25]], al.; ἕως ὧδε, [[Luk.23.5|Luk.23:5]]
(b) **here**: [[Mat.12.6|Mat.12:6]], [[Mrk.9.1|Mrk.9:1]], [[Luk.9.33|Luk.9:33]], [[Jhn.6.9|Jhn.6:9]], al.; τὰ ὧδε, [[Col.4.9|Col.4:9]] opposite to ἐκεῖ, [[Heb.7.8|Heb.7:8]] ὧδε . . . ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), [[Mat.24.23|Mat.24:23]], [[Mrk.13.21|Mrk.13:21]]; metaphorically, **here** (i.e. in this circumstance or connection), [[1Co.4.2|1Co.4:2]], [[Rev.13.10, 18; 14.12; 17.9|Rev.13:10, 18 14:12 17:9]].
(AS)

G5623.def:
**ὠφελέω**, -ῶ
(ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;]
**to help, benefit, do good, profit**: absol., [[Rom.2.25|Rom.2:25]] οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, _Notes_, 21), [[Mat.27.24|Mat.27:24]], [[Jhn.6.63; 12.19|Jhn.6:63 12:19]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.4.2|Heb.4:2]] with dupl. accusative, [[Mrk.8.36|Mrk.8:36]], [[1Co.14.6|1Co.14:6]], [[Gal.5.2|Gal.5:2]]; pass., [[Heb.13.9|Heb.13:9]] with accusative, [[Mat.15.5; 16.26|Mat.15:5 16:26]], [[Mrk.5.26; 7.11|Mrk.5:26 7:11]], [[Luk.9.25|Luk.9:25]], [[1Co.13.3|1Co.13:3]].†
(AS)

G5615.def:
**ὡσαύτως **
_adv._,
strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ᾽ αὔτως, later in one word), **in like manner, just so, likewise**: [[Mat.20.5; 21.30, 36; 25.17|Mat.20:5 21:30, 36 25:17]], [[Mrk.14.31|Mrk.14:31]], [[Luk.13.5; 20.31|Luk.13:5 20:31]], [[Rom.8.26|Rom.8:26]], [[1Ti.5.25|1Ti.5:25]], [[Tit.2.6|Tit.2:6]]; with verb to be supplied from context, [[Mrk.12.21|Mrk.12:21]], [[Luk.22.20|Luk.22:20]], [[1Co.11.25|1Co.11:25]], [[1Ti.2.9; 3.8; 3.11|1Ti.2:9 3:8 3:11]], [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]].†
(AS)

G5614.def:
**ὡσαννά (T**, ὠσ-) (Heb נָא and הוֹשֵׁעַ; see Dalman, _Words_, 220 IL; _Gr._, 249),
**hosanna**: [[Mat.21.9|Mat.21:9]], [[Mrk.11.9-10|Mrk.11:9-10]], [[Jhn.12.13|Jhn.12:13]]; τ. υἱῷ Δανείδ, [[Mat.21.9, 15|Mat.21:9, 15]].†
(AS)

G5606.def:
**ὦμος**, οὐ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שְׁכֶם, כָּתֵף ;]
**the shoulder**: [[Mat.23.4|Mat.23:4]], [[Luk.15.5|Luk.15:5]].†
(AS)

G5611.def:
**ὡραῖος**, -α, -ον
(ὥρα), [in LXX for נָאָה, טוֹב, יָפָה, etc. ;]
seasonable, timely, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, **blooming, beautiful **(both of things and persons): [[Mat.23.27|Mat.23:27]], [[Act.3.2, 10|Act.3:2, 10]], [[Rom.10.15|Rom.10:15]] (LXX, ὥρα).†
(AS)

G5604.def:
**ὠδίν**
(late form of ὠδίς), -ῖνος, ἡ [in LXX for חֵבֶל חֶבֶל (and wrongly for חֶבֶל חֶבֶל, cf. Ac, l.with), חִיל, etc. ;]
**a birth pang, travail pain**: [[1Th.5.3|1Th.5:3]] metaphorically, of extreme suffering, [[Mat.24.8|Mat.24:8]], [[Mrk.13.8|Mrk.13:8]]; ὠδῖνες θανάτου ([[Psa.18.4|Psa.18:4]] מָוֶת חֶבֶל), [[Act.2.24|Act.2:24]]†
(AS)

G5621.def:
**ὠτίον**, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς,
[in LXX for אֹזֶן ;]
**an ear**: [[Mat.26.51|Mat.26:51]], [[Luk.22.51|Luk.22:51]], [[Jhn.18.26|Jhn.18:26]].†
(AS)

G5609.def:
**ᾠόν**
(Rec. ὠόν), -οῦ, τό [in LXX for בֵּיצָה ;]
**an egg**: [[Luk.11.12|Luk.11:12]]†
(AS)

G5608.def:
**ὠνέομαι**, -οῦραι
**to buy**: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 210 ff.; Veitch, see word), with genitive pret., [[Act.7.16|Act.7:16]]†
(AS)

G5622.def:
**ὠφέλεια (WH**, -λία), -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;]
1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.).
2. **profit, advantage, benefit **(Hdt., Plat., al.): [[Rom.3.1|Rom.3:1]], [[Jude.16|Ju 16]].†
(AS)

G5605.def:
**ὠδίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for חוּל, also for חָבַל pi., etc. ;]
**to have birthpangs, to travail**: [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]] (LXX), [[Rev.12.2|Rev.12:2]] metaphorically, [[Gal.4.19|Gal.4:19]] (cf. συν-ωδίνω).†
(AS)

G5603.def:
**ᾠδή**, -ῆς, ή
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;]
**a song, ode, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ**: [[Rev.5.9; 14.3; 15.3|Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3]]; ᾠ πνευματικαί [[Eph.5.19|Eph.5:19]], [[Col.3.16|Col.3:16]].†
(AS)

G5624.def:
**ὠφέλιμος**, -ον
(ὠφελέω),
**useful, serviceable, profitable**: with dative commod., [[Tit.3.8|Tit.3:8]] before πρός, with accusative, [[1Ti.4.8|1Ti.4:8]], [[2Ti.3.16|2Ti.3:16]].†
(AS)

G5612.def:
**ὠρύομαι ** depon.,
[in LXX for שָׁאַג ;]
of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), **to roar, howl**: λέων, [[1Pe.5.8|1Pe.5:8]]†
(AS)
